description: An IStringLocalizer<TResourceSource> backed by JSON tables embedded in the resource type's assembly: {TResourceSource.FullName}.json for the neutral language and {TResourceSource.FullName}.{culture}.json per culture, each a flat { "Key": "Value" } map. The tables travel with the assembly and are never resolved through a host-supplied IStringLocalizerFactory, so an application that replaces the whole localization pipeline with its own factory still gets real text instead of raw key names; embedded JSON also resolves under Blazor WebAssembly, where resx satellite assemblies and the embedded neutral .resources are not loaded. Lookup walks CultureInfo.CurrentUICulture -> parent cultures -> neutral, each table is parsed at most once, and a missing table is an empty table rather than a failure. Register it as a CLOSED generic (IStringLocalizer<TMarker>) so it takes precedence over an open-generic registration, and pass a marker type that lives in the assembly holding the JSON files.
